tier: Tier1 exact stable package-input review; full local image and signed proof required before delivery

originalRefusals.reason: The unchanged exact-package guard refused kwin 6.8.3-2.fc44 (Fedora updates) where 6.8.3-1.fc44 was reviewed; no gate relaxed and no failed job rerun

source.specDelta: Release 2; two upstream KWin patches; Requires plasma-milou (already installed: plasma-milou-6.8.3-1.fc44); changelog. No authentication, identity, theme, API or kernel change.

patches.subject: input: only init backends after InputRedirection
patches.why: input backends could send events during construction, before the input-redirection global existed, and crash KWin

patches.subject: backends/libinput: only process device add events on startup
patches.why: switch state (tablet-mode, lid) is only communicated through events; non-ADDED events are delayed until KWin's filters exist (KDE bug 528936)
patches.onlyDifference: one hunk header's function-context label (private: vs private Q_SLOTS:), which git generates and patch ignores

admission: build_files/plasma_stable/compose.py EXPECTED['kwin'] = 6.8.3-2.fc44 only; tests keep 6.8.2-*, 6.8.3-1, 6.8.3-3, 6.8.4-1 and any other package's -2 refused
notClaimed: The libinput change concerns the V3's detachable cover (switch events at startup) but no physical detach/boot journey was run; the image gates, a signed candidate and the owner's V3 boot qualify it separately.
